decisions.reason: The existing message-146 MODIFY already captures the $5 commission, Small and Big Block ticket award, and random existing-NFT-holder recipient for no-code mints.
The existing message-146 MODIFY already captures the added NFT display location, while the mint-number basis and permanence remain unchanged.
The existing message-146 MODIFY already identifies the minted asset as the "My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal" memoir novella NFT ebook.
The existing message-146 MODIFY already records that the mint-number referral code must be visible in NFT metadata; the source does not necessarily change the other metadata fields.
The existing message-146 MODIFY already records that applicable fiat fees reduce the founder's proceeds, while the $15 price, $4 founder share, $5 commission, and prize-pool funding remain valid.
The source repeats the existing rule that an optional confirmation email may contain the mint number as referral code and does not change the candidate state.
The source repeats the already established Transak payment methods and confirms that a preexisting wallet is not required for fiat minting.
Chainlink VRF, fully on-chain provably fair selection, Basescan verification, and ticket weighting were already established and remain unchanged.
The source repeats the existing badge thresholds of 2, 10, 50, and 100+ referrals and does not alter the award rules.
The source repeats that primary and secondary sales fund the prize pools on an ongoing basis and does not change the existing funding state.
The source repeats the already established visible flat $10 secondary-sale royalty without changing its enforcement requirement.
The source repeats the existing Winners-page announcement and one-click claim workflow without changing the candidate state.
